boxes.title: Laws: added detail
items: Factories Act 1881 followed the **1875** Bombay factory commission
Trade Unions Act: protection from **civil and criminal conspiracy** suits; Joshi's resolution **March** 1921
Trade Disputes Act: long notice periods; strikes beyond purely industrial disputes illegal
AITUC founder ⚠ some notes: **N.M. Joshi**, others **Lajpat Rai**: both among founders
